providerMetadata.label: Parallel Search (Free)
providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.

providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.

providerMetadata.label: Parallel Search (Free)
providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.

providerMetadata.label: Parallel Search (Free)
providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.

providerMetadata.label: Parallel Search (Free)
providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.

providerMetadata.label: Parallel Search (Free)
providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.

providerMetadata.label: Parallel Search (Free)
providerMetadata.hint: Free web search via Parallel's hosted Search MCP — no API key required

descriptor.description: Search the web using Parallel's free Search MCP (no API key). Returns ranked, LLM-optimized dense excerpts from web sources. Pass an `objective` describing the underlying question along with 2-3 short keyword `search_queries` (Parallel's recommended pairing). For multi-step research, thread the prior result's `sessionId` back in as `session_id` to keep Parallel's context grouped.

objective.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content.

search_queries.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. Provide 2-3 diverse queries for best results (max 5). Vary entity names, synonyms, and angles. Each query is a keyword phrase, not a sentence; do not use site: operators.

session_id.description: Optional session id returned by an earlier Parallel search. Pass it on follow-up searches that are part of the same task to keep Parallel's server-side context grouped (look for `sessionId` in the prior tool result).

client_model.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gemini-3.1-pro'). Pass the exact active model slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a family alias like 'gpt-5'. Lets Parallel tailor default settings for your model's capabilities.
